instruction: Stack the three blocks with different textures.
scene: Three blocks rest on the table in front of the robot, spaced apart from one another. They are not identical: they differ in how large they are and in how they look, so each block is distinguishable from the other two.
success_rule: All three blocks sit in a single upright tower -- each one resting squarely on top of the one below it -- and the episode ends with both arms back at the start pose and both grippers open.
hints: Grasp a block from directly above, with the jaws closing on two opposite faces of it rather than on a corner or an edge.
Before releasing a block, bring it directly above the middle of the block it will rest on, then lower it straight down onto that block, and open the jaws only once it is seated.
The tower gets taller with every block you add, so each placement happens higher off the table than the one before it.
A block balances best when the block beneath it is at least as wide as the block you are putting down.
If a block topples, pick it up and build the tower again rather than leaving it lying on the table.
Anything you are still holding when the episode ends has not been placed.
